New Virus Outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus in China Five Years After COVID 19, Emergency Declared

China is grappling with a health crisis as human metapneumovirus (HMPV) rapidly spreads across northern provinces, particularly affecting children under 14.

nodes.author: mechanicJC
nodes.text: Reports suggest hospitals and crematories are overwhelmed, while health officials warn against the misuse of antiviral drugs. With a rise in multiple respiratory illnesses, including influenza A and mycoplasma pneumoniae,

nodes.text: , including influenza A and mycoplasma pneumoniae, authorities have declared a state of emergency and launched a pilot monitoring system to manage the surge in pneumonia cases and other acute respiratory diseases this winter.
